plugins.name: pipeline-smoke-test
plugins.description: Test fixture for the eds-skills pipeline that prints a greeting with a UTC timestamp and does nothing else.

plugins.name: prompt-creator
plugins.description: Acts as a prompt engineer: when the user asks to write, draft or tidy a prompt for a Claude Code session, a Cowork session or a run of sequential subagents, reads the current session for context, asks only about gaps in one batch, and produces a short prompt tuned to the target.

plugins.name: skill-create
plugins.description: Scaffolds a new skill folder that already conforms to SKILL_FRAMEWORK.md, from a declared set of metadata.

plugins.name: teach-user
plugins.description: Overrides default speed-mode and shifts into depth-calibrated explanation/teaching mode when the user wants something explained or taught rather than just delivered.
